name: Brain2Chat Connector
author: brain2chat

sections.description:
Brain2Chat Connector is a simple and efficient plugin that integrates your WordPress website with the Brain2Chat service. Similar to how Google Analytics works, this plugin adds the Brain2Chat tracking script to your website’s header, enabling you to track visitor behavior, analyze user engagement, and improve your website’s performance.

Key Features

  • Easy Setup: Simply enter your Brain2Chat token and you’re ready to go
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on your website’s performance
  • Secure: All data is sanitized and validated before use
  • Toggle Control: Enable or disable tracking without removing your token
  • Admin Notifications: Get notified when the plugin needs configuration
  • Clean Uninstall: Removes all plugin data when deleted

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to Settings > Brain2Chat
  3. Enter your Brain2Chat token (obtained from your Brain2Chat dashboard)
  4. Save your settings
  5. The Brain2Chat tracking script will automatically be added to your website

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • A Brain2Chat account and valid token

Privacy & GDPR

This plugin adds an external tracking script from Brain2Chat to your website. Please ensure you comply with GDPR and other privacy regulations by:

  • Updating your privacy policy to mention Brain2Chat tracking
  • Obtaining necessary consent from your users
  • Configuring Brain2Chat according to your privacy requirements

External services

This plugin connects to the Brain2Chat service to provide website analytics and customer engagement tracking functionality.

Service Provider: Brain2Chat (https://www.brain2chat.com)

What the service is used for:
The Brain2Chat service is used to track visitor behavior, analyze user engagement, provide chat functionality, and help improve your website’s performance through advanced analytics.

What data is sent and when:
– The plugin loads an external JavaScript file from https://www.brain2chat.com/widget/chat-widget.js on every page load when the plugin is enabled
– Your Brain2Chat token is embedded in the script tag to authenticate your website with the Brain2Chat service
– Visitor behavior data including page views, clicks, and user interactions are collected and sent to Brain2Chat servers
– The data is transmitted whenever a visitor browses your website and the tracking is enabled

Service Terms and Privacy:
– Terms of Service: https://www.brain2chat.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.brain2chat.com/privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to the Brain2Chat terms of service and privacy policy. Please ensure your website’s privacy policy reflects the use of Brain2Chat tracking.

Additional Information

For more information about Brain2Chat and its features, visit https://brain2chat.com

For support, please visit our support forum or contact us at support@brain2chat.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Brain2Chat Connector”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings > Brain2Chat to configure the plugin

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin” and choose the downloaded ZIP file
  5. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  6. Go to Settings > Brain2Chat to configure the plugin

Configuration

After activation:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Brain2Chat in your WordPress admin
  2. Enter your Brain2Chat token
  3. Ensure the “Enable Brain2Chat” checkbox is checked
  4. Click “Save Settings”
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Brain2Chat token?

You can obtain your Brain2Chat token from your Brain2Chat dashboard. Log in to your Brain2Chat account and navigate to the integration or API settings section.

Can I temporarily disable tracking without losing my settings?

Yes! Simply uncheck the “Enable Brain2Chat” checkbox in the plugin settings. Your token will be preserved, and you can re-enable tracking at any time.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most caching plugins. The tracking script is added to the HTML head section and will work correctly with page caching.

Does this plugin work with multisite installations?

Yes, the plugin supports WordPress multisite installations. Each site in the network can have its own Brain2Chat token.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, the Brain2Chat script is loaded asynchronously and won’t block your page from loading. The impact on performance is minimal.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

When you delete the plugin through WordPress admin, all plugin data (including your token) is removed from the database. The tracking script will no longer be added to your website.
